title: ArcCivs 0.1.42: finite mine geometry and preserved supplies
assumptions: Source assessment before implementing the V2 mine plan. Low/base/high are mutually exclusive target levels L1/L2/L3, with 1/10/16 city owners and 0.1/0.25/1 newly completed target-level mine per owner-day. These are sensitivity assumptions, not observed activity or imposed caps.

Extra native terrain to excavate relative to the same fully finished legacy mine is 21/35/49 unique cells for L1/L2/L3. Sequential V2 widening adds 21 then14 then14 cells; do not add21+35+49 for one mine. terrain_block is a physical volume unit, not a guaranteed item drop or monetary reward.

A complete L1/L2/L3 progression paid7/21/42 torches under legacy upgrade replay, versus7/14/21 under V2, preserving the same seven authored torch positions per floor. Positive item flow quantities record required bag debits, not mint. Missing or stolen torches and exposed-cave sealing are world-dependent and excluded from the fixed pattern calculation.

Native block/drop probabilities, the two-second mining action (ideal ceiling1800 actions/hour excluding movement/supplies), floor geometry53 cells/level and ladder depth6 blocks/level remain unchanged. No reward for already-air cells, no free material, no offline catch-up. Foreign containers and modification protection remain checked.

Farm harvest priority, bounded discovery retention and 5-tick handoffs restore useful work at unchanged1.5/3second physical harvest duration. Realized crop growth/harvest throughput and sale income are unknown, not assumed zero or assigned a guessed multiplier.

Resident profession training remains one point per accepted physical action, capped at40 per resident/profession; a fully worked mine reaches40 before and after. Retained completed work avoids repeat-action training; extra native excavation and conditional cave repairs depend on the world. This internal skill is separate from player XP.
Vault, tokens and player XP remain separately0->0. Current EconomyShopGUI SELL and the future contract transition are unchanged; no item-to-currency conversion or redemption flow is introduced.
